it_support.name: IT Support
prerequisites: Comfort with systematic troubleshooting and safe account practices

milestones.title: Build a troubleshooting foundation
practice: Explain common hardware, account and connectivity problems in your own words
Write a step-by-step diagnostic checklist for one realistic issue
milestones.deliverable: One clear support runbook covering a realistic desktop/network issue

milestones.title: Practise evidence-driven support
practice: Log and prioritise three fictional support tickets marked as practice exercises
Practise privacy-safe incident reporting and customer updates
milestones.deliverable: Three practice tickets with reproducible steps and escalation decisions

milestones.title: Demonstrate a support workflow
practice: Create a troubleshooting presentation or short portfolio case study
Review a sample role description and map genuine skills to requirements
milestones.deliverable: One self-labelled practice support case study and updated resume bullets

customer_support.name: Customer Support
prerequisites: Clear written English and listening skills
Ability to follow published company policies and protect customer data

resources.title: IBM SkillsBuild — free adult learning resources

milestones.title: Practice communication essentials
practice: Write concise acknowledgement and clarification responses
Identify facts, emotions and unresolved requests in realistic scenarios
milestones.deliverable: Four original response examples covering different customer situations

milestones.title: Build resolution habits
practice: Draft a customer issue triage and escalation checklist
Practice explaining policy without promising unauthorised exceptions
milestones.deliverable: One personal service-recovery workflow with example updates

milestones.title: Show evidence of service quality
practice: Build a practice FAQ from safe fictional scenarios
Self-review clarity, ownership and next-step quality
milestones.deliverable: Five self-written practice responses with a simple review rubric

junior_web_dev.name: Junior Web Developer
prerequisites: Basic computer use and a text editor
Willingness to build and test original small projects

milestones.title: Create a semantic webpage
practice: Study HTML structure, forms and accessible headings
Build a small page with content written by you
milestones.deliverable: One local semantic HTML page with validated form labels

milestones.title: Make it responsive and interactive
practice: Add a responsive layout with CSS
Write a small JavaScript interaction and test invalid input
milestones.deliverable: One original mobile-friendly interactive practice page

milestones.title: Publish reproducible project evidence
practice: Add a simple automated test and a project README
Record keyboard, mobile and basic security checks
milestones.deliverable: One accessible sample project with source, screenshots and a testing README

disclaimer: Curated practice plans, not accredited courses, hiring guarantees or industry certifications. Review resource links and customise progress to your own circumstances.
